authorityContacts._comment: DEMO contacts for the prototype only — not the authorities' real phone numbers / e-mails; replace with RSSP / RAP API data

registry._comment: US-141 AC-02: the RAP API's issuing authorities (+ subdivisions = the office that issued the act). Real Moldovan public authorities, the same names / codes as data/autoritati.json (merged at runtime, autoritati.json wins). The demo registry spreads its padded acts over every authority except `noActs` — those never reach the „Autoritate emitentă” facet (≥ 1 active act). `actTypes` (US-141 AC-03 „Tip act”): real permit types, each with the authorities that issue it — the padded acts cycle through them.
